content: I just realised that I am getting automatic style fixes for that. That's quite cool. Since when is it enabled?

Ah I see, first time I saw the commit.

I just thought that general formatting could be done in CI, which would be a huge deal.

An official formatter hasn't been released yet, but yeah

Mathlib's pre-commit currently only removes trailing whitespace, makes sure the last line of the file ends with an EOL, and fixes some annoying line-ending issues for Windows users that haven't configured git/vscode right
This topic was moved here from #PR reviews > Is pre commit CI enabled? by Anne Baanen.
(I'll move this to mathlib4 since it is not directly about reviewing any particular PR.)
Ah, true. I put it in PR reviews since I noticed it during a PR.

Snir Broshi said:

An official formatter hasn't been released yet, but yeah
